title: 8-Week Interview Prep Tracker
subtitle: Pattern-first (Weeks 1-5) -> Company-tagged drilling (Weeks 6-8), with growing spaced-review load.

rules.label: Cold-first
rules.text: Always attempt a new problem cold for 20-25 min before opening the labuladong write-up or a NeetCode video. If you crack it cold, log it as 'Cold' — that's the signal that matters, not just 'solved'.

rules.label: Never fully drop a pattern
rules.text: Once a pattern's drilling week has passed, keep at least 1-2 reps/week alive via the Review Tracker — interviews can land with no notice, so nothing should go more than ~10 days untouched.

rules.label: Log immediately
rules.text: Fill in the tracker row right after each problem, not at the end of the day — approach quality and mistakes are accurate for about 5 minutes after you finish.
